title: SaaSTelemetryRecord
description: Validation schema for SaaS Customer Retention and Causal Telemetry records.

account_age_months.description: Tenure of the customer on the platform in months

active_users_ratio.description: Ratio of licensed seats actively utilizing the product

login_frequency_trend_30d.description: Relative percentage velocity in logins over last 30d compared to prior 60d

feature_usage_diversity.description: Count of distinct product features used in last 90 days

support_tickets_90d.description: Total support tickets created in trailing 90 days

unresolved_p1_tickets.description: Number of Sev-1 critical support tickets currently unresolved

payment_failure_events.description: Failed dunning/billing attempts in last 90 days

treatment_assigned.description: Binary treatment indicator: 1 if received proactive retention intervention, 0 if control

retained.description: Factual observable outcome: 1 if retained, 0 if churned

y_control_latent.description: Latent counterfactual outcome under control Y(0)

y_treated_latent.description: Latent counterfactual outcome under treatment Y(1)

tau_true.description: True latent Individual Treatment Effect: Y(1) - Y(0)
